name: PAY_TEMP_OBJECT_ACTIONS
description: This table contains temporary actions that are only required while a process is in progress.

columns.name: PAYROLL_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the Payroll Relationships table

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to a database object defined by the Object Type

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of object that the object id is pointing to

columns.name: PAYROLL_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the PAY_PAYROLL_ACTION Table

columns.name: ACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Valid statuses for an object action.

columns.name: CHUNK_NUMBER
columns.description: Number used to group events into chunks for parallelization.

columns.name: ACTION_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Absolute sequence number to determine physical order of events.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
